summary: Designer-side guardrails for suppression, label painting, and layout-safe table/group rendering.

microPatches.change: Do not render imported suppressed fields; hide DI text, questions, and decorative labels without affecting underlying semantic metadata.
Prefer explicit widget names and stable SIDs over OCR text labels when reconciling semantic labels on import.
Preserve independent semanticGroupIds, row groups, choice sets, and address blocks while merging PDF widgets into the designer catalog.
Carry table metadata through widget replacement and retain row/column alignment for table-derived layouts.
